senses.example: Quedamos a las siete en el bar.
senses.exampleGloss: We are meeting at seven in the bar.

alternatives.reason: The meeting itself rather than the arrangement; close but not identical.
More formal, one side arranges; quedar is mutual.
Colloquial and slightly LatAm-flavoured; understood but less Peninsular.

notes: quedar has several senses (to remain, to suit, to arrange); only the meeting sense is taught here.
